## Change

Describe the consumer-visible behavior and why it changes.

## Evidence

Commands/scenarios exercised and their observed outcomes. State missing device/vendor prerequisites explicitly.

## Checklist

- [ ] Regression covers a meaningful boundary, transition, precedence or error.
- [ ] Actual changed path exercised; no fabricated SDK/vendor result.
- [ ] Docs and changelog reflect the contract.
- [ ] No credentials, captures, private notes or tool binaries included.
